body:
Sit. Stay. Good. The dog is invited to this one.
Sit Stay Lake Geneva is a newly renovated lower level retreat with two king bedrooms, a queen sleeper sofa, a laundry room, and a fully fenced backyard with a deck and firepit. Downtown Lake Geneva, the Riviera, and the lakefront are minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DogFriendly #DogFriendlyTravel

Some houses host the holidays. This one headlines them.
Grand Luxe Geneva Lakefront is one of the few luxury rentals directly on Geneva Lake, with eight bedrooms, seven and a half baths, a wood burning fireplace, a sport court, and a private pier. Holiday gatherings, milestone celebrations, and New Year's on the water all fit here.
December weekends at this level go early.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #HolidaysAtTheLake

A 1910 Lake Geneva home, restored with real care and ready for the holidays.
Sage Street Bungalow sleeps eight in three bedrooms, with a brand new kitchen, high end finishes, a main level queen bedroom, and a firepit patio for crisp evenings. A ramp entrance makes coming and going easy, and the Geneva lakefront and downtown are less than a mile away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #HistoricHome #HolidaysAtTheLake

Sunsets over Lake Mary, and Wilmot Mountain a short drive away.
Twin Lakes Escape is a private lakefront home on the southern shore of Lake Mary, with six bedrooms and three full baths for fourteen, a fireplace, and a pier and firepit at the water. Spend the day on the slopes and the evening back at the lake.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#TwinLakesWI #LakeMary #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #SkiSeason #WilmotMountain

An hour from Milwaukee, ninety minutes from Chicago, and a world away by Friday night.
Cocktails & Dreams is a bright ground level Abbey Villa condo in Fontana with an updated kitchen, a gas fireplace in the living room, two patios, and two bedrooms plus a Murphy bed for six. Fontana's beach, restaurants, and shops are minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #GenevaLake #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #CozySeason

Cold outside. Arcade downstairs. Problem solved.
The Blackstone is an end unit townhome with a full basement arcade and game lounge: classic cabinets, ping pong, and screens for game day. Three bedrooms and two and a half baths sleep eleven, close to downtown Lake Geneva.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #GameNight #Arcade

One of the closest homes to the Geneva Lake waterline, with the lake in view from nearly every room.
Haven at Water's Edge is a multi level lakefront estate with five bedrooms and four baths for sixteen, a gourmet kitchen, a primary suite with lake views, a top floor bunk room, a fenced yard, and its own pier. The Lake Geneva Shore Path and downtown are close by.
Winter on this shoreline is quiet, bright, and wide open. Holiday dates are booking now.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #ShorePath

A month at the lake sounds better every time you say it out loud.
Nautical Nest is a renovated cottage in Fontana's Glenwood Springs neighborhood, available as a monthly rental. A bright open kitchen and dining space, a screened porch, a gas fire pit out back, and two bedrooms for six.
Winter and spring months are open now. Ask about availability.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #GenevaLake #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #MonthlyRental #StayAWhile

Two suites, two coasts, one hallway, and the whole group downtown for the holidays.
Coast to Coast combines the LA and New York suites into one rental with separate living quarters, two kitchens, three bedrooms, and room for twelve. Main Street shopping, the Riviera, and downtown dining are right outside.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #HolidayShopping

A log home in winter is not a rental. It is a mood.
Log Home at Lake Geneva is an updated Fontana log home with a soaring great room and fireplace, a table that seats twelve, a game room with ping pong and shuffleboard, and a movie room. Four bedrooms, three and a half baths, and room for ten.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #LogHome #WinterWeekends

A gas fireplace, a wall of windows, and Lake Benedict right outside.
Hayley's Hideaway is a quiet lakefront home on Lake Benedict with five bedrooms for twelve, an open kitchen with a big island, and a pier and lawn for the warmer months. Winter here is calm, bright, and very easy to settle into.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeBenedict #GenoaCity #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #WinterOnTheWater

A front porch that glows at dusk, two blocks from downtown Lake Geneva.
Sheldon House is a historic three bedroom home with a gas fireplace, a manicured garden patio, and room for eight. Downtown shops and restaurants are two blocks one way, and the public beach is three blocks the other.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #HistoricHome #HolidaysAtTheLake

Ski all day at Wilmot, then come back to a private spa and a sauna.
Lakeview Terrace in Twin Lakes sleeps twelve across three bedrooms and three baths, with lake views through the upstairs windows, a dining table for eight, an island kitchen, and a ground floor spa and sauna made for cold days. Wilmot Mountain is a short drive away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#TwinLakesWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Sauna #SkiSeason #WilmotMountain

Holiday dinner in a formal dining room, with history in every corner.
Poolside at Fairfields Mansion is a one of a kind historic Lake Geneva estate offered exclusively through Geneva Lakes Vacations, with six bedrooms for fourteen, a study and library, a lower level theater, and downtown and the lakefront close by.
December dates at a property like this go early.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #HistoricHome #HolidaysAtTheLake

Quiet luxury on Delavan Lake, with the water in view from the main living space.
Delavan Landings is an architect designed, newly built lakefront home with high end finishes, surround sound, and one connected living, dining, and lounge space facing the lake. Two bedrooms, two and a half baths, a balcony, and a path down to the shoreline.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#DelavanLake #DelavanWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #LakeLife

Camping season is over. Glamping season does not end.
The Glamping Loft is downtown Lake Geneva's first and only indoor glamping experience: five tents inside a historic loft, a full bar with swing seats, a living wall, and room for twelve, steps from Main Street and the lake.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Glamping #DowntownLakeGeneva

Cathedral ceilings, a fireplace, and a wooded street inside Abbey Springs.
North Shore Hideaway spreads ten guests across three finished levels and four bedrooms, with an open living and dining space, basement ping pong, and access to the Abbey Springs community amenities. Fontana's lakefront and restaurants are minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #AbbeySprings #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #CozySeason

A quiet tree lined street, a gas fireplace, and Lake Como a few blocks away.
Opal Serenity sleeps ten on one thoughtfully designed level, with a king primary suite and private bath, a queen guest room, and a bunk room. A peaceful base for winter weekends, with everything the Lake Geneva area does well a short drive away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeComo #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #WinterWeekends

Eighty four feet of shoreline, and a lake that is wonderfully quiet this time of year.
Four Gables on Green Lake is a tri level lakefront home in Lauderdale Lakes near Elkhorn, with four bedrooms, three and a half baths, a gas fireplace, a lower level den and bar, and outdoor seating on every level. The firepit sits right at the water's edge.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LauderdaleLakes #GreenLake #ElkhornWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront

Three cities, one hallway, and seventeen of your favorite people downtown for the holidays.
The Downtown Trifecta combines the Chicago, New York, and LA suites into one Main Street rental with adjoining but separate spaces, four bedrooms, three baths, and on site parking. Together for the fun, apart for the sleep.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #GroupTravel

A stone fireplace, a table for ten, and nothing but trees outside the windows.
Into The Woods is one of Lake Geneva's newest rentals, a five bedroom retreat tucked among mature trees about ten minutes from downtown. The open kitchen has an island and modern appliances, the living room centers on the fireplace, and a sun filled sitting room opens onto a large deck.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #FiresideSeason #WinterGetaway

Winter weekends are better with the dog, so bring the dog.
Paws at the Lake is a cozy, dog friendly three bedroom, two bath home in Twin Lakes near Lance Park, with room for six and the essentials for you and your four legged travel partner. Wilmot Mountain is a short drive away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#TwinLakesWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DogFriendly #DogFriendlyTravel #PetFriendly

A stone fireplace, fairway views, and the quiet side of Abbey Springs in winter.
Fairway to Heaven is a three bedroom, two and a half bath condo on the 10th fairway in the Abbey Springs community, with a gas fireplace in the living room and room for seven. Fontana's restaurants and The Abbey Resort are a short drive away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #AbbeySprings #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #FiresideSeason

Holiday shopping on Main Street, then home to your own apartment right above it.
Rooftop on Main is an upscale two bedroom apartment with a mid century modern style, an updated kitchen, and a private rooftop deck in the heart of downtown Lake Geneva. It sleeps six and books quickly, so holiday weekends deserve a head start.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #HolidayShopping

Pleasant Lake sunsets do not take the winter off.
Woodhaven on Pleasant Lake is a peaceful East Troy getaway with three bedrooms for eight, a vaulted living room with a fireplace, and a deck aimed straight at the sunset. Quiet water, big skies, and an easy reset.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#PleasantLake #EastTroyWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #LakeLife #SunsetViews

Seventeen guests, six bedrooms, and the whole holiday season downtown.
The Downtown Geneva Street Bungalow is a 1902 home with layered, character filled living spaces, three and a half baths, and a kitchen that handles a crowd. Geneva Lake is two and a half blocks away, and Main Street's shops and restaurants are right around the corner.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #GroupTravel

New construction, a gas fireplace, and a theater room for long winter nights.
Luxe at the Lake sleeps fourteen across five bedrooms, with a big kitchen island, a dining table for a crowd, a covered patio with a firepit, and finishes that live up to the name. The beach is just across the street when summer comes back around.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #LuxuryRental #HolidaysAtTheLake

What if winter at the lake was not a weekend, but a month?
Fontana Lakeside Haven rents by the month, with four bedrooms, a fireplace, a vaulted living room, and a screened porch for the warmer days. It is a comfortable base for remote work or a slow season close to The Abbey and Geneva Lake.
Monthly dates are limited. Ask about winter and spring availability.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #GenevaLake #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #MonthlyRental #StayAWhile

Water on three sides, and a sunroom that puts all of it in view.
Peninsula Paradise on Rice Lake brings the Northwoods feel without the long drive: a point location, a sunroom on the water, a lower level den with a wet bar, a private pier, and a fire pit for clear, cold nights. Three bedrooms, two baths, and room for eight near Whitewater.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#RiceLake #WhitewaterWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #WinterOnTheWater

Knotty pine, a round table for game night, and Geneva Lake a few blocks away.
The Delavan Suite at Geneva Beach House is a two bedroom, two bath suite with an open kitchen and living space and room for ten. The Riviera, the Shore Path, and downtown Lake Geneva are all close by.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #CozySeason

High log ceilings, a stone fireplace, and the kind of quiet Abbey Springs does best in winter.
The Lodge at Geneva Lake sleeps twelve across five bedrooms, with an open floor plan, a gas fireplace, and classic lake home character inside the gated Abbey Springs community in Fontana.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #AbbeySprings #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #LogHome

Small town Wisconsin at the holidays: coffee shops, taverns, and a comfortable place to land.
The Main Event puts you in the center of the Village of Walworth with three bedrooms for six, close to local restaurants, coffee shops, and community events. Fontana, The Abbey Resort, and Lake Geneva's shopping are minutes down the road.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#WalworthWI #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #SmallTownWisconsin #HolidaysAtTheLake

The quiet inlet side of Delavan Lake, with a stone fireplace for the cold mornings.
This spacious waterfront home sleeps eleven across five bedrooms, with a fireplace, a big backyard, a fire pit, and a private pier on the secluded inlet. Lake Geneva is about twenty minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#DelavanLake #DelavanWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #FiresideSeason

Clean lines, big light, and downtown Lake Geneva close at hand for the holiday season.
Modern Waters is a new construction townhome with three bedrooms, three baths, and smart sleeping space for fourteen, centrally located near the lake, the shops, and downtown dining.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #HolidaysAtTheLake

A stone fireplace, golf course views, and a quiet wooded corner of Abbey Springs.
Sail Away is a professionally redecorated Abbey Springs condo across three levels, with room for six. Fontana's lakefront, The Abbey Resort, and local restaurants are minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #AbbeySprings #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #WinterWeekends

Next summer's pool days start with a booking this winter.
The Cabana is a three bedroom, two bath retreat about a mile from downtown Lake Geneva, with a private heated saltwater pool, an outdoor kitchen, and a bar in the backyard, plus a gas fireplace inside for the cooler nights. Summer weekends book early, so now is a good time to plan.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #PoolDays #PlanAhead

A stone fireplace, a wall of windows, and Powers Lake right outside.
The Lake House on Powers is a bi level lakefront with incredible frontage, a private pier, a bonfire pit, and a lower level rec room with a pool table. It sleeps twelve, with Lake Geneva's restaurants about fifteen minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#PowersLake #GenoaCity #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #Lakefront #LakeLife

Room for ten, a fireplace in the living room, and the Fontana lakefront close by.
West End Escape is a modern end unit townhome on the west end of Geneva Lake, with four bedrooms, two and a half baths, two private balconies, and a screened porch. A bright base for holiday gatherings on the quiet end of the lake.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #GenevaLake #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #HolidaysAtTheLake

Trees on three sides, a gas fireplace in the middle, and a covered balcony for watching winter roll in.
The Luxe at Abbey Villa is a second story condo with a fully renovated kitchen, two bedrooms and two baths for six, and a resort feel without resort prices. Fontana's restaurants and lakefront are minutes away.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#Fontana #GenevaLake #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #CozySeason

String lights, a covered pergola, and two words downtown regulars love to hear: with parking.
The Geneva is a newly built end unit townhome close to downtown Lake Geneva, with three bedrooms, two and a half baths, thoughtful finishes, and clever sleeping for fifteen.
Book direct at genevalakesvacations.com.
#LakeGeneva #LakeGenevaWI #GenevaLakesVacations #VacationRental #DowntownLakeGeneva #WinterWeekends
